usedFor: BioSkepsis answers life-science questions: “Start Research Run” returns a cited answer and “Create Research Feed” follows new papers.

bestTemplate.name: “Start Research Run” in BioSkepsis
bestTemplate.why: It starts a run that answers a life-science question with citations, so a question becomes a sourced brief.

watchOut: “Create Research Feed” sets up a scheduled email feed, so check the topic and who receives it.
